data.name: Maharlika IX
data.notes:
I would like to introduce Maharlika IX, a Filipino-built, neutral Internet Exchange designed to make local interconnection affordable and accessible for every network in the Philippines, from national carriers to provincial ISPs. Our goal is to keep local traffic within the country to lower latency, reduce transit costs, and build a more resilient local Internet.

Key Highlights:

  - Extended Fabric: Our coverage extends across Metro Manila, Rizal, and Bulacan, bringing the exchange closer to member networks.
  - Fair Access: Simple, cost-effective port pricing designed to give regional ISPs and community networks equal access to content and peering.
  - Security: MANRS-approved IXP. Our route servers enforce RPKI origin validation and IRR filtering based on PeeringDB AS-SET records, while rejecting bogons.

Peering Details:

  - Route Servers (AS9420):
      - 163.223.201.1 / 2001:df0:a940::9420:1
      - 163.223.201.2 / 2001:df0:a940::9420:2
  - Requirements: Please ensure your PeeringDB record and AS-SET are up to date, as our route-server filters are built directly from them.

data.name: ERA-IX Frankfurt
data.notes:
A new era of peering!

The future of peering on internet exchanges is under pressure, due to ever-growing costs, high number of failures, and a "too corporate" culture. In mid-2022 two internet pioneers decided to bring a better and more cost-effective alternative, and we never looked back. 

### Our mission
It is our mission to redefine peering, by offering an innovative and cost-effective IXP ecosystem. The current state of peering is not-so-great and in a headlock by large corporate IXP-operators.

### Our way
We are truly neutral, fully privately owned and funded. Powered by a new generation of internet pioneers, our goal is to offer transparent and enterprise-ready connectivity services with a human touch.

### About us
We are the new-generation connectivity partner, fully privately owned and funded. We have built a next-generation connectivity fabric across major datacenters in Amsterdam and Frankfurt. [Read more](https://www.eranium.io/about) about our initiative.

### Latest news
Connect now with 400G! Read more about it on our [blog here](https://www.eranium.io/blog/114/the-new-fabric-and-400g).
